issuer: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
title: Circular on Transition from IPC to BNS — Police Training & Implementation
content:
All State Police forces directed to:
1. Transition to filing FIRs under BNS sections effective 01 July 2024.
2. Old IPC FIRs filed before 01 July 2024 will continue under IPC.
3. Police officers to be trained on BNS, BNSS, and BSA by April 2024.
4. Dual reference (IPC + BNS) to be maintained in case files for transition period.
PRACTICAL IMPLICATION: For lawyers, always check whether incident occurred before or after 01 July 2024 to determine correct law (IPC vs BNS).
